title: Did not fit!
text: Did not fit!. The package of filters I received was in the Bissell sealed poly bag and marked to fit my vac. It did not fit. It was too long and too wide. It was clearly the fault of the Bissell factory and not Amazon.

How to keep vacuums running and looking their best

There’s nothing like a quick sweep of the vacuum to freshen a home. It’s a small thing that can make a big difference, much like changing or cleaning the filters in your vacuum. Just like carpets need special care, so do vacuums. Did you know that a BISSELL bagless vacuum may have up to three filters? If you begin to notice performance issues, it may be time to either replace or clean your filters. For non-washable filters, we recommend they be replaced regularly for optimal performance. Clean filters are important as they help to capture dust and other particles that pass through the filter while vacuuming. To get the most out of your vacuum, remember to clean or replace your filters regularly and rely on specially designed filters directly from BISSELL.
